responsibility: This header declares the catalog of function_shape objects used by the AArch64 SVE builtin framework. It names the generic prototype/overload families—such as unary, binary_opt_n, compare_scalar, load_gather_sv, ternary_lane, reduction, store_scatter_offset, and many others—that aarch64-sve-builtins*.def files reference when describing ACLE intrinsics.
same_name_distinction: In the aarch64-sve-builtins-shapes pair, this header is only the published list of function_shape objects and naming conventions; the actual parsing, prototype construction, and overload-resolution behavior lives in aarch64-sve-builtins-shapes.cc.
